notes.title: 🎬 Demo Co-Op Playthrough
notes.content:
Celebrate the launch of the Crimson Capes demo with us!

All week long, we’ll be streaming epic battles — raw co-op hunts, ruthless invasions, and every deadly feint in between.


If you’ve ever wanted to see what it’s really like to fight side by side — or face off blade to blade — this is your call to arms.


 Join the hunt and come meet us on the battlefield!
